title: Uu Kodathara? Ulikki Padathara?
desc: Rayudu, the present head of an erstwhile royal family, owns a palace which is also home to a few ghosts. A malicious ghost tries to ruin Rayudu's daughter's wedding to settle an old score.

title: Mirchi
desc: Manasa falls in love with Jai after he helps her and manages to win the hearts of her family with his good deeds. However, she is unaware that he belongs to a rival family.

title: Tholi Prema
desc: Fate offers Aditya and Varsha the opportunity to rekindle their youthful romance years after personality differences compelled them to go their separate ways.

title: Vinaya Vidheya Rama
desc: Facing a menacing criminal kingpin, Ram fights to protect his family. Soon, he embarks on a daring mission to topple the villain and dismantle his corrupt empire.

title: Inkokkadu
desc: Love invents a lethal drug and gives it to terrorist outfits, who use it to kill Indian officials in Kuala Lumpur. When RAW officers find a love emblem tattoo on his neck, they start investigating.

title: Doosukeltha
desc: When Chinna lands in a hospital due to a sting operation he conducted for a channel, he falls for Dr Alekhya. However, Alekhya's life turns out to be in danger and Chinna decides to help her.

title: Seema Raja
desc: Seema Raja, the generous and carefree prince of Singampatti, becomes a responsible king and the saviour of his people after his grand-uncle reveals to him the history of his heroic heritage.

title: Fun Time
desc: The programme includes comedy clips from Tollywood movies.

title: Naa Peru Seshu
desc: A tough police officer investigates the murder of an inspector. His findings lead to the arrest of an influential man, putting his own life, career and family at risk.

title: Solo
desc: Gautam, an orphan, wishes to marry a woman from a joint family and his dream comes true when he falls in love with Vaishnavi. However, Vaishnavi's father is against their marriage.

title: DJ Tillu
desc: Bala Gangadhar Tilak, also known as DJ Tillu, is a young man who wishes to become a disc jockey someday. However, his life changes after he falls in love with Radhika.

title: Policeodu
desc: A police officer goes into hiding to bring up his daughter in a safe environment. However, after her life is threatened by deadly gangsters, he must face his past to protect his daughter.

title: Pushpa
desc: Pushpa, a labourer, makes powerful enemies as he climbs the ranks of red sandalwood smuggling. However, chaos erupts when the police launch a crackdown on his illegal syndicate.

title: Manjummel Boys
desc: After one of them falls inside a dangerous pit in the Guna Caves, a group of childhood friends muster courage to rescue him out of a space from where a return is next to impossible.
